requirements.evidence: Migration matches schema incl. unique (entity_id,email) and cascade (migration:16-24); model mutator normalizes email (EntityInvite.php:33-38); sendInvite validates, checks member/pending, replaces expired, catches QueryException, rate-limits only on success (Members.php:42-104); PendingInvites accept/decline with 403, expired error, idempotent no-op, firstOrCreate, session + redirect (PendingInvites.php:13-61); mail markdown 'emails.entity-invite' with all keys and pt_BR strings; route ->can('update','entity') (web.php:56); modals with ui.members_details header, name first, no empty option, removal confirmation modal without wire:confirm. Gaps: the 'invite' error is rendered only inside @if ($invites->isNotEmpty()) (pending-invites.blade.php:2-7), so an expired-invite error is invisible when no other invite is listed; for the owner membership memberRole='owner' has no matching <option>, so the select shows a wrong value.

conventions.evidence: New domain writes (invite creation, acceptance, role change) live directly in Livewire components instead of app/Actions/* (Members.php:77-90, PendingInvites.php:31-36); validation uses inline $this->validate([...]) and the #[Validate] import was removed (Members.php:48-51, 150-152) rather than the project's #[Validate] pattern; invitee authorization is abort_unless($this->isInvitee(...)) rather than a policy (PendingInvites.php:17,53); migration filename 2026_10_29_000001 looks hand-named rather than generated. Positives: #[Fillable] set, CHANGELOG, business-rules and database-schema docs updated, reversible down().

security.evidence: Every Members action authorizes 'update' and resolves IDs scoped to $this->entity (Members.php:117,134,145-148); accept/decline check invitee e-mail server-side; rate limiter per manager+entity; all output via {{ }}; mass assignment via #[Fillable]. Minor: selectedMembershipId is a client-writable non-#[Locked] property (Members.php:29) — mitigated because saveRole re-scopes it to the entity; confirmRemoval/cancelRemoval have no authorize (only UI flags).

tests.evidence: Extensive Pest coverage in EntityInvitesTest.php and MembersTest.php: normalization, factory/expired state, unique index, happy path with mail/audit, validation, member/pending conflicts, rate limit incl. invalid input not consuming quota, foreign cancelInvite 404, accept 403/expired/idempotent/no duplicate, decline, switcher/onboarding hr, mail rendering in en/pt_BR, route 403, openMember foreign, saveRole owner/last manager, removal modal. Weak spots: the 'race' test never triggers the QueryException catch (it just exercises the pending-check path); no tamper test setting selectedMembershipId to a foreign id before saveRole.

simplicity.evidence: Generally direct. Some duplication: e-mail is normalized three times (Members.php:46 and 53 plus the model mutator); the 'pending' query (whereNull('accepted_at')->where('expires_at','>',now())) is repeated in Members.php:59, 214 and PendingInvites.php:69-70 while the model has an unused isPending() helper instead of a scope.

readability.evidence: Clear method names and audit logs, consistent with sibling style; sendInvite is somewhat long (Members.php:42-105) mixing checks, throttling, persistence, mail and logging; Mailable keeps generator boilerplate (empty attachments()).

scope.evidence: All changes serve the task: model/migration/factory, components, views, lang keys, route gate, docs and changelog; no unrelated refactors found.

issues.explanation: New domain writes (send invite, accept invite) are implemented inline in Livewire components instead of dedicated app/Actions/* classes that authorize inside, as the conventions require.
Validation uses inline rule arrays and drops the #[Validate] attribute pattern the project mandates for Livewire properties.
Invitee authorization is a hand-rolled abort_unless check rather than a policy/gate under app/Policies.
The @error('invite') message sits inside @if ($invites->isNotEmpty()), so accepting an expired invite when no other pending invite exists shows no feedback.
Opening the owner's membership prefills memberRole='owner', which has no matching option, so the select displays a misleading role.
The 'unique-constraint race' test never reaches the QueryException catch; it only exercises the pre-insert pending check, leaving the race handling untested.
selectedMembershipId is client-writable and not #[Locked]; saveRole re-scopes it to the entity so impact is limited, but there is no tamper test for it.
E-mail normalization is repeated despite the model mutator, and the pending-invite query is duplicated instead of a model scope.
Migration filename suggests it was hand-written rather than produced by make:migration.

review.summary: The change replaces direct member addition with a complete invite flow (table, model, factory, queued mail, PendingInvites component, manager-only members page with detail and removal modals), with broad tests and updated docs. Functionally it is close to complete, but new domain writes bypass the mandated app/Actions layer, validation and invitee authorization deviate from the #[Validate]/policy conventions, and a few edge cases (invisible expired-invite error, owner role select, untested race path) need fixing before merge.
